text:
nina: Heads-up team 1: Mariner Health RFI packet needs final answers. I uploaded capability_matrix.csv and draft_rfi_responses.docx to /deals/mariner/rfi. Buyer wants: explicit POC throughput, HSM/KMS options (on-prem + cloud), VPC peering/diagram, and three pricing bands + single-month dedicated POC fee. Can ops/security/finance review by EOD Wed?

tom: I'll take HSM/KMS copy. Reuse boilerplate where possible: Private = BYO-HSM (PKCS#11) + optional private control plane; Dedicated = cloud KMS/CMEK with customer key ownership; Hosted = cloud KMS integration only (no raw key exposure). Adding note about attestation steps and recommended key rotation.

axel: Ops note: POC throughput is model + prompt-shape dependent. Conservative numbers to include: `13B family on 4xA100: ~395 req/s (16 tok avg)`; `70B family on 8xA100 equiv: ~88 req/s`. I'll paste a tiny CSV with assumptions.

sophia: Finance: buyer asked bands at 15k / 150k / 1M tokens/mo plus a single-month dedicated POC price. Can finance give hosted vs dedicated delta and propose an egress cap range? Also they asked about cancellation terms for the POC.

nina: Also note they asked for eu-west-1 residency. Confirm Dedicated/Private can be region-locked via routing policies; control plane caveat needs to be explicit (console/analytics may live outside EU unless private control plane purchased).

axel: CSV snippet:```
model,instance,baseline_reqs_per_s,burst_reqs_per_s,assumptions
mar-13b,4xA100,395,710,16 token avg; warmed KV cache
mar-70b,8xA100,88,160,16 token avg; large-context opt
embed-lite,2xA100,1150,1850,embedding-only workload
```

tom: Draft HSM paragraph (paste):

"Private deployments: support customer-provided HSMs via PKCS#11/NSS interfaces. We provide an integration guide, sample attestation scripts, and recommended key-rotation cadence; the customer manages key lifecycle. Dedicated: supports cloud KMS/CMEK with customer key ownership; hosted: integrates with provider KMS only and we do not store raw key material. For customers requiring FIPS-validated HSMs, Private deployment is recommended."

sophia: Quick finance ballpark: hosted baseline rate (for 15k/150k/1M) = $0.0012 / token band (example), dedicated premium +20% same bands, single-month dedicated POC = $11k (legal review). Egress cap: propose 1x MRR for short-term POC; can negotiate based on SOC/contract. I'll post final table by Tue EOD.

nina: Buyer blockers: 1) legal wants sample egress liability clause and a proposed cap; 2) infra wants a short POC->prod handover runbook. Who owns runbook?

axel: Ops will draft a 1-2 page runbook. I'll include warmup steps, autoscale toggles, and a minimal checklist for handover (metrics, alert thresholds, config diff). Will paste skeleton by Tue noon.

tom: Also flag for rfi: call out operational caveats in the matrix rows: quantization accuracy impact, fallback policy (if Dedicated saturated we route to compatible hosted variant with changed SLA). Mark those as caveats.

nina: Action items:
- tom: finalize HSM paragraph + compliance note (FedRAMP/IL mapping) due Tue EOD
- axel: finalize throughput CSV + runbook skeleton due Tue noon
- sophia: finalize pricing bands + egress cap suggestion due Tue EOD
- nina: assemble final draft and run internal sign-off Wednesday

sophia: tagging pricing-bot to generate draft cost table: @pricing-bot please generate rough bands for 15k/150k/1M tokens and a dedicated-month line so I can sanity-check.

pricing-bot: Generated draft bands attached to /deals/mariner/rfi/pricing_draft.csv. Hosted base, dedicated +20%, POC-month suggestion $11,000.

axel: Pasting runbook skeleton:
- Pre-POC: confirm region + VPC peering, provision recommended instance sizes, seed KV cache.
- Warmup: run 1000 synthetic prompts to populate KV cache, check latency targets.
- Scaling: commands to increase autoscaler min/max + sample `kubectl` snippet.
- Handover: checklist for configs, IAM roles, key ownership proof, and monitoring dashboards to hand to customer.

tom: I'll add a 2-sentence FedRAMP mapping note to security paragraph and ping compliance.

nina: Scheduling 30m readthrough Wed 10am. If anything blocks, flag here. :thumbsup:
